newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BASLER HOPEFUL OF RECOVERY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BASLER HOPEFUL OF RECOVERY.

text.p: Bayern Munich midfielder Mario Basler hopes he will recover from a thigh strain in time for Sunday's derby clash with 1860 Munich.
Basler sustained the injury while playing for the German national side in Wednesday's 2-0 win over Ukraine.
"I'm feeling better," Basler said after taking part in light training on Friday. "I'm getting injections and I think we'll manage to make it in time for Sunday."
The midfielder scored Germany's second goal on Wednesday and has been in outsanding form for Bayern in the last few weeks.
